title: Didn't perform as expected
text: Didn't perform as expected. They hold a lot of stuff, but not one bag stayed compressed for very long. I'm not sure their seal is comparable to similar products, like the Ziplock vacuum seal bags, or the bags you fold over to remove all the air.  Maybe I tried to put too much in the bags, but I don't recall seeing any great instructions on that subject.  They're fine if all you want to do is put things on bags to keep the dust off, but if you mainly want to compress the bags and contents to save space, stick with the name brands you find at the local retail store.
